caveat: Measured on a generic 12-class insect-ID dataset (Ants/Bees/Beetles/etc.), NOT on the project's real Kenyan pest/disease taxonomy — this validates the pipeline end-to-end, not real-world detection accuracy on any of the 15 target classes. Instrumented on Intel Core Ultra 5 228V CPU (8 threads, batch=1). Forward pass (50.0 ms) isolated via time.perf_counter() strictly measuring neural tensor multiplication, separate from image decompression (8.06 ms). Accuracy reflects 5-epoch CPU fine-tuning on 12-class dataset.
